name: Osiris
body:
Osiris, having been killed and dismembered by his brother Set, was brought back to life by his wife Isis. Because of his resurrected nature, Osiris is the Lord of the Field of Reeds—the blessed place where worthy souls can live again in happiness after their mortal death.

Osiris appears as a human mummy wrapped in white strips of linen with greenish-black skin which symbolizes his resurrected status. Osiris’s hands rest crossed at his chest. One hand holds a scepter and the other holds a flail. A tall, white, conical crown sits atop Osiris’s head.

Farmers who rely on the seasonal cycles of regrowth, and all those who hope for resurrection after death, pay homage to Osiris.

Afterlife

Granted Powers: Your deity grants you the power to resurrect the dead, fill others with hope for the future, and discover the good or evil nature of an individual’s soul.

Just Reward (Sp)

You can use this ability to reward a non-evil creature for its good deeds. As a standard action, you can touch a willing, nonevil creature to grant it a boon. The creature can choose to receive a +1 sacred bonus to their armor class, a +1 sacred bonus on saving throws, or a number of temporary hit points equal to your cleric level. Regardless of which boon is selected, it lasts for a number of rounds equal to your Wisdom modifier. This ability has no effect on animals, constructs, oozes, undead, or vermin. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

Effortless Healer (Ex)

Starting at 8th level, any spell you cast that has the word “cure” in it heals a number of additional hit points equal to 1/2 your Wisdom modifier (round down, minimum 1). Additionally, once per week, when you cast a spell that brings a creature back to life, you can use only half the normal value of components and the creature’s negative level(s) are automatically restored after 24 hours.

Domain: 1st-protection from evil, 2nd-good hope, 3rd-analyze aura, 4th-discern lies, 5thplane shift, 6th-holy sword, 7th-resurrection, 8th-euphoric tranquility, 9th-akashic form.
